title.narrative: Enhancing Young Sudanese Women Participation in Political Transformation (ESWPIPT)

description.narrative: This action seeks to contribute to the increased agency, empowerment and political participation of (young) Sudanese women activists in Khartoum and South Darfur States and to improve the capacity of women-networks from the same areas to successfully push their agendas in relevant decision making processes. Both groups will be supported to participate in capacity-building trajectories and engage in peer learning forums. Their access to knowledge on political participation strategies and to technologies for experience sharing and networking will be improved and they will get to know other women activists/groups. The action will engage also with men as key-influencers and power holders to address structural and deep-rooted discriminatory gender and social norms and to create a favorable environment for womens meaningful participation in political and local decision-making platforms. Finally, the action aims to strengthen the capacity of local institutions women-networks at state level and women-led organizations at the national level in networking, effective communication, policy analysis and advocacy to enable them to effectively participate in political processes at community, county and state level
